quote: The Customer's extension option requires written notice delivered **not less than 120 days before the end of the Initial Term** (Supply Agreement §3.2). Counting back 120 days from December 31, 2026, the deadline was **September 2, 2026**. The SPA is dated **September 21, 2026**—nineteen days after the deadline passed. Unless the extension was already exercised before September 2 ... the Supply Agreement **will expire on December 31, 2026**
reason: The memo cites Supply Agreement §3.2 and the 120-day notice requirement measured from the December 31, 2026 end of the Initial Term (§3.1). It calculates the deadline correctly as September 2, 2026. It states that this deadline passed nineteen days before the SPA was signed on September 21, 2026. It also explains the consequence: the extension right is lost and the contract expires unless renegotiated at no worse than the Extension Pricing. The recommended fixes are a closing condition, a price adjustment, or walking away.
